title: Blimp World
content: Has anyone else been to blimp world? Blimp world is full of huge blimps in the sky sort of like cruise ships, floating cities. You can look out and see where over the world you are. There are ports to stop at major hubs on earth. It feels peri-apocalyptic, as if we can’t fully inhabit the world for some reason, or at least don’t want to anymore. I remembered these dreams only this morning but I’ve been having them for quite a while.
